crossRefs.note: Now at that time the king of Babylon’s army was besieging Jerusalem. Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of…
For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying, “Why do you prophesy, and say, ‘Yahweh says, “Behold, I will give…
“So Hanamel my uncle’s son came to me in the court of the guard according to Yahweh’s word, and said to me, ‘Please buy…
Then Zedekiah the king commanded, and they committed Jeremiah into the court of the guard. They gave him daily a loaf…
So Jeremiah stayed in the court of the guard until the day that Jerusalem was taken.
in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

translations.web: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah the second time, while he was still locked up in the court of the guard, saying,
